evidence_state: public_literature_index_only; no independent reproduction or new model runs

sources.title: Looking Inward: Language Models Can Learn About Themselves by Introspection
sources.scope: Behavioral self-prediction advantage in constrained experimental tasks
sources.limitation: Does not establish consciousness or unrestricted privileged introspective access

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.scope: Activation-injection reports under selected experimental conditions
sources.limitation: Reports were unreliable, sensitive to interventions, and not evidence of subjective experience

sources.title: Can LLMs Introspect? A Reality Check
sources.scope: Adversarial and input-only control evidence for putative introspection
sources.limitation: Challenges a strong privileged-access interpretation; settings differ from positive studies

sources.title: A mechanistic study of language model introspection
sources.scope: Mechanistic causal analysis of restricted model reporting tasks
sources.limitation: Task-specific preprint results cannot be generalized to all architectures or human consciousness

sources.title: Identifying Introspection From the Inside
sources.scope: Causal attribution patterns for learned artificial preference self-reports
sources.limitation: Artificial preference setup and constrained adapters are not a general awareness assay

sources.title: Detecting the Disturbance: A Nuanced View of Introspective Abilities in LLMs
sources.scope: Binary self-report logit shift confound, localization and relative-strength detection
sources.limitation: Task- and early-layer-specific preprint results; not independently replicated by ARE SelfModel Lab
